review.notes: review of the change against main: 251 changed lines since aecb53a; checked every added origin, method and corollary label and the revised 10.1, 10.2 and headline (4) against the cited supplier sections at this head (AdelicAlgebraicGroups 4.5a; AutomorphicFormsOnReductiveGroups 6.8a, 7.5, 7.5a; AutomorphicSpectralTheory 6.4a; AutomorphicBundles 0.5, 5.3a, 5.3b; NoncompactQuantumSymmetry Layer 3 item 3 on main), against the seeded sample's locators in mumford-1977, hc-1953, thorne-2012, hecht-schmid-1975, muller-1989 and two fetched arXiv texts (16 locators), and by computation (invariant metrics on the adjoint bundle of X(N); central characters of the bundles giving omega and Lie_sigma); automatic checks all pass except the check for files changed outside the roadmap folder, a false positive (the pull request's own folders); dependency check 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with no warnings and declares nothing. One finding (P2): the kept hypothesis 'unitary on K_inf' excludes the Hodge-bundle summands that the new labels, the 10.2 Check and the downstream paragraph apply 10.1/10.2 to. Not verifiable: Sun 2007, Zuckerman 1977, Gould 1980/1985, Atiyah-Schmid 1977, Harris 1989, Dixmier-Malliavin 1978, and the uncertified Gross 1999, Harish-Chandra 1966, Muller 1998.
